prompt: Explain Myron Golden's 'Window of Opportunity' and the 'financial house' of the poor, middle class and rich.
assertions: Four panes: Have A Job (H.A.J.), Own A Job (O.A.J.), Sow Money Seeds (S.M.S.), Own A System (O.A.S.)
Have/own a job are the two worst ways; Own A System best; Sow Money Seeds second best
Financial house windows: income, outgo, wealth reducing liabilities, income producing assets
Poor: all income goes out the outgo window
Middle class: buy wealth reducing liabilities / live in debt keeping up with the Joneses
Rich: buy income producing assets; difference is what you do with money, not how much you make
